title: The Ghost in the Allocator
author: wanderer
description: There is a certain melancholy in the lifecycle of a memory block. It is born, it serves a purpose, and it is freed. But in the fog of complex drivers, we sometimes forget that *free* does not mean *gone*.

title: Entropy & The Sublime
author: wanderer
description: Friedrich painted the sublime as an overwhelming experience of nature. In cryptography, the sublime is true randomness. When I analyzed the firmware of the generic IoT camera, I found not chaos, but order — seeded by `time(0)`.

title: Obscurity is not Safety
author: wanderer
description: Standing above the sea of fog, one cannot see the path below. Yet, the path exists. Security through obscurity relies on the fog remaining forever. But the wind always blows eventually.

title: 'Reflections on Trusting Trust', but completely by accident this time
author: wanderer

title: Rustld: Implementing a User-Space Dynamic Loader in Rust
author: louislafosse
description: A modern (and working) ELF x86_64 & aarch64 loader (static & dynamic linker + compatible glibc & musl) written in Rust
